name: Lewd Island
source:
After a plane crash you and a female passenger find yourselves on an abandoned island.

Will help arrive?
Were there other survivors?
What will happen?
What will you find?
You play and YOU decide!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/xred]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一场空难过后，你和一名女乘客发现自己流落到了一座荒岛。

救援会来吗？
还有其他幸存者吗？
接下来会发生什么？
你会发现些什么？
亲自游玩，一切由你决定！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/xred]Patreon[/url]]
